title: Chapter 5: The Battle Of The Insects
content:
Chapter 5: The Battle Of The Insects

The four colonies were built first, and Wu Qing chose to evolve two defensive spikes and two air defense towers to strengthen the territory's defense.

All the newly born larvae will hatch into puppies. All the upgradeable items of the puppies at this stage have been upgraded. They are in a state of full combat power and are the most cost-effective.

Under the command of Wu Qing, a host flew its huge body to the newly built defensive spikes and air defense towers at the edge of the territory, and stopped hanging close to the ground.

With the host's super long-range vision and anti-invisibility ability, the black shadows wandering outside the territory finally showed their true colors. They were all weird creatures with no shape at all and terrible twists.

Wu Qing could roughly guess their prototypes from some of the characteristics of these strange creatures. For example, those with green skin on their bodies and a pig's head on their chest. Maybe they were originally green-skinned and pig-headed people.

"Mental control first, then physical distortion?"

Wu Qing thought of the strange spiritual energy bodies attached to the puppies, and combined with the monsters in front of him, he had some guesses.

"Such a weird combination can't be tolerated by ordinary people!"

He felt that the world was not normal, and there was such a terrifying thing coming out at night.

"I don't know if it's just my bad luck, or if it's the whole world."

"Looking at the reaction of the green men, they should be aware of this situation."

"If the whole world is like this, how can ordinary people survive?"

Wu Qing thought again of the God's name and firm belief that the Greenskins chanted, as well as the mysterious power in the camp they built.

"Does the god of this world really exist?"

He was a little curious about this question.

Wu Qing no longer thought about it. He entered the nest and observed the situation outside through the host's vision.

"whee……!"

"Woooo...!"

The laughter outside the territory turned into shrill whimpering again.

"Although it's a bit cliche, the scary and weird atmosphere is conveyed well. He is a talented person who makes horror movies!"

Wu Qing complained that the collective consciousness of the Zerg is now a trump card in his hand. In ordinary crises, the mental intensity of the collective consciousness of the Zerg can be enough to protect himself.

So he was not panicked.

Perhaps they sensed the existence of a powerful spiritual force in the Zerg territory, and the guy behind it wanted to use physical means to eliminate the Zerg territory.

Accompanied by terrifying laughter and whimpering sounds, the twisted creatures in the darkness began to test and attack.

Seven or eight weird things that completely violated the laws of biology and physics rushed out of the woods and stepped onto the organic spread of the Zerg like a meat carpet for the first time.

As soon as these things entered the Zerg territory, a row of thick ground thorns pierced out from the ground, piercing several strange creatures from bottom to top.

If an ordinary person received this stabbing, his anus and intestines would definitely be severed and he would die on the spot.

But these strange creatures are extremely tenacious. After being stabbed, they can still get up and continue to stagger forward.

Not long after, another row of thorns pierced out, and now only two strange creatures were left that could still walk as fast as flying.

These two strange creatures rushed towards the nearest defensive position.

Suddenly a bunch of puppies emerged from the ground next to them, and with two crackles, they were torn into pieces.

The puppies continued to pounce, tearing apart all the strange creatures that were stabbed by the ground thorns.

It's not that dogs have such a hobby, but the weird creatures that are broken into several pieces are still active and very energetic.

The system's physical energy conversion is turned on, and the strange creatures on the ground disappear.

No matter what they are made of, these strange creatures eventually become system resources and make due contributions to the development of the Zerg.

"Woooo...!"

The laughter outside disappeared, leaving only the sound of crying. Wu Qing had been listening to this sound, and he felt bored.

The loss of the strange creature seemed to make the unknown being angry.

The strange creatures around the Zerg territory began to collectively become agitated, and suddenly, like the zombie tide that Wu Qing had seen when playing games, they rushed towards the Zerg territory in dense numbers.

An offensive and defensive battle officially kicked off!

The defensive ground thorn attacks with full force. The number of enemies does not affect its attack effect. All enemies in a line will be damaged.

The puppies who were resting in the ground and the newborn puppies gathered together and all pounced forward, blocking the impact of the strange creatures from all directions in the territory.

This is a brutal face-to-face combat, but the strange creatures don't care, and the puppies don't care either.

Life and death are meaningless to them.

10 Hydralisks join the battle, gather together, and spray terrifyingly powerful spikes in the direction with the most weird creatures. A single volley can knock down a swarm of weird creatures.

The numerical advantage of the strange creatures is too huge, and the number of puppies is limited, causing the battle line to continuously advance towards the Zerg territory.

Wu Qing sat calmly in the mother nest, gathering mining worker bees to build 10 colonies and two mother nests in the territory.

All the newly born larvae from the three existing mother nests have hatched into puppies.

What the Zerg are best at is such a war of attrition. Now that they have the support of real-time material-energy conversion function, they can collect resources during the battle and use the battle to support the war, they are no longer afraid of such a war of attrition.

The puppies were one against many, and the strange creatures had tenacious vitality, which caused loopholes in the defense. The strange creatures quickly rushed to the vicinity of defensive structures such as spikes.

The Zerg's buildings are not so easy to push.

With the resources delivered by the strange creatures, Wu Qing's 10 defensive ground spikes that he built urgently have evolved.

In an instant, the entire Zerg territory seemed to be a bamboo forest in spring, with countless ground spikes emerging.

The strange creatures rushing in front were directly pierced to pieces by the numerous ground spikes.

In the small Zerg territory, the defensive ground spikes are densely distributed. The ground spikes that keep piercing can both kill and block the enemy, greatly slowing down the attack speed of the strange creatures.

At this time, the number of mother nests reached 5, and every minute, 10 puppies can be hatched, and the puppies continue to join the battlefield.

This put the entire battlefield into the stalemate that Wu Qing wanted.

There are lives disappearing every moment. Although the two lives of the enemy are not normal lives, the scene is indeed very cruel.

Fortunately, whether it is the strange creatures or the Zerg, the remaining corpses have been cleaned up by the system, and it does not look so bloody.

A terrifying and strange spiritual energy lingered outside the Zerg territory, constantly trying to influence the creatures in the Zerg territory.

In the Zerg territory, except for Wu Qing, a normal person who was a little irritated after hearing the creepy cry, other Zerg units were not affected at all.

The stalemate battlefield situation slowly changed.

The strange creatures put all their strength into it, and they were the most fierce at the beginning. As long as their first wave of attacks were resisted, their number would decrease and the intensity of their attacks would continue to weaken.

The Zerg was just the opposite. Due to resource constraints, they were the weakest in the early stage. With a large amount of resources sent by the enemy personally, plus the fast construction and hatching speed, they became stronger and stronger.

With the persistence of a large number of defensive spikes, plus the speed of increasing 10 puppies every minute, the number of puppies in the Zerg territory soon increased against the trend.

The number of puppies increased, and the battlefield had entered the counterattack stage.

At this time, none of the Zerg's defensive buildings were destroyed, and the Zerg only lost a large number of puppies.
